note: The first task in F5 to be REJECTED, and the reject was earned. REJECT #1 (commit 571cfb8) raised two findings, both accepted without argument. Finding 1 was the familiar earned-guardrail failure: _loop's falsy-read branch had no test, and it carried a real consequence the implementor had flagged the semantics of but not the coverage gap — break left status RUNNING with the camera still held, so a transient read failure killed the preview silently and a restart would have orphaned the device. Finding 2 is the interesting one and is the source of this task's lesson: the drop-don't-queue behaviour was tested only as a pure function (pacing_delay), while the loop-level test asserted read_count >= len(received) — something true BY CONSTRUCTION of the loop. The verifier proved the gap concretely by replacing wait(pacing_delay(...)) with a flat wait(FRAME_INTERVAL), deleting the behaviour outright, and observing all 23 tests still pass. Right shape, empty substance; the injected clock existed with no test using it for its purpose. The fix was two tests discriminating in opposite directions, and — because the whole finding was that passing tests can be hollow — the implementor verified them by MUTATION rather than by assertion alone (3/3 caught, source restored byte-identical), which the verifier then independently repeated and extended to 4/4. Learn scan outcome: a lesson cleared the bar and is PROPOSED, pending human approval, parked in handoff.md; project.md was NOT written unapproved. It clears both limbs: it cost a full verify cycle, and it will recur immediately (Task 7 pins BoothApi wiring and a camera-failure branch, and F6-F9 follow). Overlap-checked across problem, root cause, fix, files and prevention against all four existing guardrails: it is ADJACENT to 'never add a helper, method, or branch that no caller and no test exercises' and to the F4.5 fake-stream rule, but distinct from both — those catch surface with NO test, whereas this catches surface WITH a test whose assertion would still hold if the behaviour were deleted. Enforcement was considered first per learn step 5 and rejected with reason: a real mutation-testing tool (mutmut, cosmic-ray) is a new dependency requiring a TECH-PICK and is disproportionate for this repo, and no lint rule can detect a vacuous assertion — so prose is the honest fallback, with the cheap manual technique named in the rule.
